ig_caption:
Can Jev hallucinate? Here's the catch 🎯

Jev can only return answers you allowed, so it never invents a new category.
⚠️ but it can still pick the WRONG allowed one: "info" on the alert that's about to take prod down

That's what the probability is for:
✅ high confidence → automate
✅ low confidence → send to a human
✅ test it on your own data first (on TypeSafe's own benchmark Jev scored about 6 points below the best LLMs)

Fast and cheap is great. Don't trust it. Test it.

Part 3 of 4. Next: when to use Jev.

yt_description:
Can Jev hallucinate? Jev only returns values from the answer set you define, so it can't invent a new category. But it can still choose the wrong valid answer. Use the calibrated probability: automate above a threshold, route the rest to a human, and test on your own data.

Benchmark: on TypeSafe's own benchmark Jev scored 67.8% vs 74.1% for the best LLM listed (DataCamp, Sept 2026).
